_about: Human review of the keyframes: what the automatic judge accepted and what an Ethiopian viewer rejected. Notes in quotes are the director's own words during review on 26 Nov 2026.

s02.human_said: "The person is an Indian person, not Ethiopian."
s02.change: Rewrote the character: Habesha Ethiopian man from Addis Ababa, deep brown skin, East African features, most important words first. Added a strict 'do the people look Habesha?' score to the judge (v2) and 4 candidates for the father.

s04.human_said: A European-style church dropped into a canyon, not a church carved down into the rock like Lalibela.
s04.change: Named the landmark: Bete Giyorgis in Lalibela, cross-shaped, carved down into red rock, flat roof with carved crosses.

s05.human_said: The elders wear Middle-Eastern head cloths; Ethiopian elders wear the white gabi, bare-headed.
s05.change: Described deep brown skin, white handwoven gabi shawls, bare heads, low wooden stools.

s03.human_said: "The cloth of the father must be Ethiopian when he walks with the child"; "the child must be a boy, and similar before and after growth."
s03.change: Wrote a new prompt (side view, white gabi with tibeb border, jodhpur-style trousers; the boy as the young Abba). Not rendered: the free image quota ran out (FAILURES F15).
